How to create a spiral plate
In the drop-down menu of the creation plate tool group, find the create spiral tool and click on the 2D window.
The radius is used to set the center line of the spiral plate.
The length is used to set the length of the inner and outer sides of the spiral plate.
The side edge is used to set the width of the inner and outer sides of the spiral plate.
The limit is used to adjust the limit between the spiral plate.
The input limit is the distance from the center line to the middle line of the next spiral.
Direction is used to set the rotation direction of the spiral plate
The pipe position will adjust the compass
summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration: Creating Spiral Panels ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to create a spiral plate using the tools available in Marvelous Designer 12. ## Creating a Spiral Plate To begin, navigate to the drop-down menu of the creation plate tool group. Here, you will find the "Create Spiral" tool. Click on it to access the 2D window. ### Setting the Radius The **radius** is an essential parameter that is used to set the center line of the spiral plate. It determines the overall size of your spiral. ### Adjusting Length The **length** parameter is utilized to set the length of both the inner and outer sides of the spiral plate. This will define how far the spiral extends outward. ### Configuring Side Edges The **side edge** setting allows you to adjust the width of the inner and outer sides of the spiral plate. This is crucial for achieving the desired thickness of the spiral design. ### Adjusting Limits The **limit** function is used to modify the boundary between the spiral plate sections. This ensures that you can control how the spirals interact with each other. ### Input Limit The **input limit** defines the distance from the center line to the middle line of the next spiral. This measurement is critical for maintaining consistent spacing in your design. ### Setting Direction The **direction** parameter is essential for establishing the rotation direction of the spiral plate. You can choose to spin it clockwise or counterclockwise, depending on your design needs. ### Pipe Position Adjustment Finally, the **pipe position** feature will adjust the compass, allowing you to orient the spiral in the desired direction for your project. ## Conclusion By following these steps, you can effectively create and manipulate spiral plates in Marvelous Designer 12. Experiment with these parameters to achieve unique designs tailored to your creative vision. ```
